comment: SK Hynix delivered a record quarter with 328% YoY revenue growth and 632% YoY operating-profit growth, well above consensus. The archived excerpts tie this directly to AI-driven high-bandwidth memory (HBM) demand. Archived source E2_5f0f6cf3 reports the company expects memory shortages to persist past 2030 and has pre-sold over 50% of its 2027–28 output to 14 major buyers, which supports a durable demand thesis. External web excerpts confirm the AI-infrastructure link but are limited to publisher metadata and excerpt-only coverage — no full article text was fetched. The value chain extends beyond the direct beneficiary: AI memory demand is also bidding up NAND/flash (E2_375311fa) and constip

ideas.thesis: SK Hynix posted record Q3 revenue and profit driven by AI memory demand, and the company has pre-sold over 50% of its 2027–28 output, indicating a durable demand pipeline.
ideas.risk: The stock jumped ~8% on the news; the record quarter and long-term supply agreements may already be reflected in the price.

ideas.thesis: SK Hynix’s HBM is a critical component in NVIDIA’s AI GPUs; record HBM demand and multi-year supply commitments signal strong, sustained GPU production volumes.
ideas.risk: NVIDIA’s own revenue may already price in HBM procurement; the earnings beat at its supplier does not guarantee further GPU upside.
